en: Illustrated Easter/spring postcard showing three large colored eggs in the foreground beside pussy-willow branches and small flowers. Behind them stand ruins of an old stone castle or fortress on a hill. To the right is a townscape with a church featuring a tall, narrow spire and simple clock or round window on its tower, with low houses and a river or plain beyond. The greeting text at the top is in Estonian.
